DIAGRAM SYSTEM - CONTENT, CHOICES, AND PUBLICATION
|
|-- [R] Immutable revision archive
|   `-- DiagramRevision
|       |-- id / diagramId / parentId?         revision ancestry
|       |-- nodeRefs: parsed node ID -> stable logical identity
|       `-- diagram: Diagram
|           |-- diagramId / revisionId        service identities
|           |-- id / revision                 local content key + version
|           |-- content: DiagramContent
|           |   |-- ascii / asciiSha256 / content revisionId
|           |   `-- structure
|           |       |-- diagram: freeform text
|           |       `-- tree: rootIds + nodes
|           |           `-- label / coordinates / parent / children / folds
|           |-- sourceContext
|           |   |-- binding? -> repository / corpus / domain profile
|           |   |-- mappings[] --join by entity + range--> evidence[]
|           |   `-- contentHash == hash(ascii)
|           `-- jumps? / legacy highlights?
|
|-- [W] Write and publish
|   |-- AgentChat supplied ASCII -> ChatDiagramTools -> submitDirect
|   |   `-- pin base revision + scope; batch targets one canvas snapshot
|   |-- generateDiagram -> generator.generate -> submitStoredDiagramEdit
|   |-- submitDiagramEdit
|   |   |-- validate generated content, identities, and replacement scope
|   |   `-- scoped patches OR whole replacement -> create/reviseDiagram
|   |-- create / revise / deriveDiagram
|   |   `-- prepare -> validate -> freeze revision --retain--> [R]
|   |-- DiagramRevisionStore: get / list / import / retain
|   `-- MappingDocumentController
|       |-- expectedVersion + expectedRevisionId guard installation
|       |-- install revision; reconcile anchors and folding
|       `-- historyService.append -> saved canvas checkpoint
|
|-- [P] Placement and presentation
|   |-- DiagramNode = Node<'diagram', {diagramId, revisionId}>
|   |   `-- content reference --resolves to--> [R]
|   |-- DiagramPresentation = NodePresentation<DiagramPresentationState>
|   |   |-- nodeId / parentPresentationId? / geometry
|   |   `-- view: display / folds / alternative IDs / panel IDs / highlights
|   |-- document.diagramPresentations[contentId]
|   |   `-- highlights + marker rules/styles; no content revision issued
|   `-- [A] document.alternatives
|       |-- items[id]: DiagramAlternative
|       |   |-- presentationId / name / diagramId
|       |   |-- parentAlternativeId? -> nested choice
|       |   |-- reviewId? --optional association--> [V]
|       |   `-- parts[]: disjoint targets in one base revision
|       |       |-- target: whole diagram OR subtree nodeRef
|       |       |-- source: revisionId + scope --pins--> [R]
|       |       `-- baseRevisionId --pins comparison/context--> [R]
|       |-- selected[presentationId]: active choice IDs
|       |   `-- nested choices require active parent; overlaps rejected
|       `-- panels[id]: DiagramSidePanel
|           `-- attaches part to placement + nodeRef; flow/overlay, reg/diff
|
|-- [D] Display composition
|   |-- [A] -> alternativeSelections -> resolveRevisionLines
|   |   `-- compose source rows from [R]; apply logical-node folds
|   |-- projectSelectedDiagramRows -> text runs + source provenance
|   |   `-- selected whole-diagram diff -> projectAlternativePart
|   `-- Choosing displayed content leaves the bound revision unchanged
|
`-- [V] Review and apply
    |-- DiagramRevisionReview --pins base/head revisions--> [R]
    |   `-- owner scope / accept-reject decisions / last applied review
    |-- revisionChanges -> logical-node additions, removals, updates
    |-- save decisions -> review metadata only
    `-- applyRevisionReview
        |-- check structural dependencies + three-way field conflicts
        |-- preserve unrelated current edits; derive result if changed
        `-- controller installs result --publishes through--> [W]
